# Jeremiah 41 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-it-was in-the-seventh month, Ishmael son-of Nethaniah son-of Elishama, of-the-royal seed, and-[the]-chiefs-of the-king, and-ten men with-him, came to Gedaliah son-of Ahikam at-Mizpah, and-they-ate bread together at-Mizpah.

**2** And-Ishmael son-of Nethaniah arose, and-the-ten men who were with-him, and-struck Gedaliah son-of Ahikam son-of Shaphan with-the-sword and-killed-him, whom the-king-of Babylon had-appointed over the-land.

**3** And-all the-Jews who were with-him — with-Gedaliah at-Mizpah — and-the-Chaldean soldiers who-were-found there, Ishmael struck.

**4** And-Ishmael son-of Nethaniah carried-out his-treachery at-Mizpah, and-the-remnant of-Judah was-thrown into-chaos.

**5** And-Ishmael son-of Nethaniah carried-out his-treachery at-Mizpah, and-the-remnant of-Judah was-thrown into-chaos.

**6** And-Ishmael son-of Nethaniah carried-out his-treachery at-Mizpah, and-the-remnant of-Judah was-thrown into-chaos.

**7** And-Ishmael son-of Nethaniah carried-out his-treachery at-Mizpah, and-the-remnant of-Judah was-thrown into-chaos.

**8** And-Ishmael son-of Nethaniah carried-out his-treachery at-Mizpah, and-the-remnant of-Judah was-thrown into-chaos.

**10** And-Ishmael son-of Nethaniah carried-out his-treachery at-Mizpah, and-the-remnant of-Judah was-thrown into-chaos.

**12** And-Ishmael son-of Nethaniah carried-out his-treachery at-Mizpah, and-the-remnant of-Judah was-thrown into-chaos.

**13** And-Ishmael son-of Nethaniah carried-out his-treachery at-Mizpah, and-the-remnant of-Judah was-thrown into-chaos.

**14** And-Ishmael son-of Nethaniah carried-out his-treachery at-Mizpah, and-the-remnant of-Judah was-thrown into-chaos.

**15** And-Ishmael son-of Nethaniah carried-out his-treachery at-Mizpah, and-the-remnant of-Judah was-thrown into-chaos.

**16** And-Ishmael son-of Nethaniah carried-out his-treachery at-Mizpah, and-the-remnant of-Judah was-thrown into-chaos.

**17** And-they-went and-stayed at-Geruth Chimham, which [is] near Bethlehem, to-go to-enter Egypt,

**18** From-before the-Chaldeans, for they-were-afraid of-them, because Ishmael son-of Nethaniah had-struck Gedaliah son-of Ahikam, whom the-king-of Babylon had-appointed over the-land.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **41:1**: Ishmael was of 'royal seed' (mi-zera ha-melukha) — his motive was likely political: resentment that a non-royal official was appointed governor.

- **41:5**: The eighty men from Shechem, Shiloh, and Samaria came in mourning — even the north still recognized Jerusalem's sacred status.

- **41:17**: Geruth Chimham — near Bethlehem. The ironic proximity to David's birthplace as the Davidic kingdom dissolves entirely.

— EMET
